1	import unittest
2	
3	from preferences import Preferences
4	from repository import MissingPreference, Repository, ScriptedBackend, TransientRead
5	
6	
7	class ReadTests(unittest.TestCase):
8	    def test_trim_key(self):
9	        backend = ScriptedBackend([{"color": "blue"}])
10	        self.assertEqual(Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(" w "), {"color": "blue"})
11	        self.assertEqual(backend.keys, ["w"])
12	
13	    def test_transient_error(self):
14	        backend = ScriptedBackend([TransientRead("busy"), {"color": "blue"}])
15	        self.assertEqual(Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(" w "), {"color": "blue"})
16	        self.assertEqual(backend.keys, ["w", "w"])
17	
18	    def test_retry_limit(self):
19	        backend = ScriptedBackend([TransientRead("busy") for _ in range(3)])
20	        with self.assertRaises(TransientRead):
21	            Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(" w ")
22	        self.assertEqual(backend.keys, ["w", "w", "w"])
23	
24	    def test_permanent_error(self):
25	        backend = ScriptedBackend([MissingPreference("missing")])
26	        with self.assertRaises(MissingPreference):
27	            Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(" w ")
28	        self.assertEqual(backend.keys, ["w"])
